name: Hidden Chart Daily
loop: A masked price path is revealed in five stages; after each stage you guess the asset class, era and regime from clues, fewer clues used means a higher score.
hook: Deduction with a shrinking clue budget; one shared puzzle makes talking about it easy.
risk: Reveal could leak a real ticker; masked data must be genuinely unidentifiable.

name: Spoiler-Free Grid
loop: Six consecutive up/down calls on one masked path; the result is a row of colored squares that shows how you did without revealing the path or answers.
hook: Emoji-free grid share, instantly comparable and spoiler-safe.
risk: Could be read as a tipping game if the path is later named; keep it masked forever.

name: Shared Seed Roguelike
loop: Everyone gets the same seeded 3-minute run of paper trades with random events; you play it once and the leaderboard shows paper return only.
hook: Same dungeon for all, one attempt, bragging rights without grind.
risk: Leaderboard pressure may drive risk-seeking; label paper results as not skill proof.

name: Three Bar Mystery
loop: You see three candles of a masked path and set a probability for the fourth closing higher; the answer and your Brier score unlock after you lock in.
hook: A one-minute puzzle that teaches calibrated probability.
risk: Brier score is jargon; need plain wording like closeness score.

name: Odd One Out Charts
loop: Four charts are shown, three from real masked history and one synthetic; spot the generated one and explain nothing, then see which tells gave it away.
hook: Forensic spot-the-fake puzzle that builds chart intuition.
risk: Mixing synthetic and real needs clear labelling after reveal to avoid mistrust.

name: Friends First Reveal
loop: Drag a range for where the masked path will end; results are hidden until your friends in the group have all played, then everyone compares at once.
hook: Waiting-for-the-group tension drives return visits.
risk: Group pressure and nagging notifications; no streak punishment.

name: Archive Shelf
loop: Past daily puzzles sit on a shelf; play any you missed unranked, and each completed one fills a codex page about the pattern it taught.
hook: Catch-up without guilt; finite catalog gives completion without a daily treadmill.
risk: Archive answers are known online, so scores there must be unranked.

name: Regime Detective
loop: Given a masked chart, classify its regime (trend, range, shock, squeeze) then pick which of three follow-up paths is the true continuation.
hook: Two-step deduction with a clear right answer to discuss.
risk: Regime labels are subjective; need ground-truth rules published.

name: Close The Gap
loop: An anonymised verified closed trade is described by its entry chart; guess the probability it finished as a winner, then see the real result.
hook: Uses the app's own verified records as the puzzle source.
risk: De-anonymisation of traders; strip dates, sizes and assets, aggregate with k-anonymity.

name: Wrong By Design
loop: Five claims about a masked chart are shown, one false; find the false claim, a puzzle about reading charts honestly rather than predicting them.
hook: Zero prediction pressure, pure reading skill.
risk: Low connection to the verified-record core; may feel off-brand.

name: Ladder Of Clues
loop: Commit a probability for the final direction, then buy extra clues with points; each clue lets you revise, but earlier confident calls are scored higher.
hook: Tension between information and commitment.
risk: Pay-for-clue mechanic must use puzzle points only, never money.

name: Same Seed Duel
loop: Send a friend a link to today's seed; each of you rides one synthetic path with hold-to-ride, and the link shows both curves side by side.
hook: Zero-setup challenge, finite, no matchmaking.
risk: Hold-to-ride can feel like a slot lever; cap at one ride.

name: Percent Only Crossword
loop: A small grid is filled by matching clues like worst drawdown or longest streak to the correct masked chart tiles.
hook: Slower, calmer puzzle for people who dislike fast tapping.
risk: Content authoring cost per day; needs automated clue generation.

name: Shape Matching Pairs
loop: Eight chart thumbnails flash briefly; swipe to pair those drawn from the same hidden asset on different timeframes.
hook: Memory plus pattern sense in 90 seconds.
risk: Leaderboard on speed encourages rushing; rank by accuracy first.

name: Tomorrow Closes
loop: Everyone picks up or down for a broad index close tomorrow; the group tally and your results appear the next day in a shared friend board.
hook: True shared daily event with a natural next-day payoff.
risk: Reads as a market-timing signal; show only paper results and disclaimers.

name: Weekly Meta Puzzle
loop: Seven daily puzzles each give one letter-like symbol; solving the week's meta-puzzle on day seven needs good answers from earlier days.
hook: Rewards attendance by curiosity, with a weekly payoff and no loss.
risk: Missing days blocks the meta; offer archive catch-up.

name: Draw The Path
loop: Draw a cone around where a masked path will go over the next ten bars; narrower cones that still contain the path score more.
hook: Rewards honest uncertainty over bravado.
risk: Cone drawing on mobile is fiddly; needs handles and presets.

name: Crowd Median Guess
loop: Guess the probability that most players will call a masked move up; you score by closeness to the crowd's median, a pure crowd-guessing puzzle.
hook: Meta-game about reading the crowd.
risk: Rewards herding, the opposite of the product's honest-record ethos.

name: Pocket Dungeon Day
loop: Daily seeded dungeon of five paper-trade rooms with one modifier (thin liquidity, gap risk); finish with the best risk-adjusted curve.
hook: Roguelike flavour inside a finite daily cap.
risk: Gamified modifiers could trivialise real risk concepts.

name: Grid Of Calls
loop: A five by five grid of tiny charts, each hiding an up/down outcome; clear as many cells as possible, a wrong call ends the line.
hook: A mine-clearing risk feel with shareable pattern.
risk: Streak multiplier risks compulsion; cap and reset daily.

name: Event Timeline Sort
loop: Five anonymised events are shown out of order alongside a price path; drag them into the order that fits the path's turning points.
hook: Sequencing deduction like a timeline puzzle.
risk: Anonymised events can still be identifying; use abstract descriptions.

name: Which Came First
loop: Two masked charts side by side; swipe toward the one from the earlier era, using volatility texture and tick size as clues.
hook: Fast 60-second guess with clear learning on how markets changed.
risk: Answer set small; repeats quickly. Needs deep pool.

name: Verified Or Not
loop: Two anonymised trade summaries: one from verified records, one deliberately synthetic with edited stats; swipe to the real one.
hook: Teaches what real trade stats look like, including how rare perfect ones are.
risk: Synthetic records mimicking verified ones may blur the Verified meaning.

name: Friends Heat Map
loop: After playing, a friend group sees a grid of everyone's probabilities versus truth by puzzle day, building a month-long calibration heat map.
hook: Long arc of private friend comparison without public ranking.
risk: Social comparison shame; keep per-friend opt-in and softened wording.

name: One Shot Bracket
loop: Eight masked paths are paired into a bracket; pick the one with the larger final return each round, with one pick per round and no undo.
hook: Familiar bracket tension in a compact form.
risk: Predicting returns rather than reading; keep paths historical and masked.

name: Mirror Match
loop: Play the same seeded path as yesterday's top player's ghost: your calls appear alongside theirs and you win ties by earlier correct calls.
hook: Learn from a ghost without human exposure.
risk: Ghost stats may encourage copying; show only after you commit.

name: Reverse Reveal
loop: You see the end of a masked chart and the final year; drag a range for where it started, working backwards like a detective.
hook: Inverts the usual prediction direction and feels fresh.
risk: Little connection to trading decisions; frame as pattern reading.

name: Risk Budget Puzzle
loop: Allocate a fixed risk budget across four synthetic paths shown only as volatility cones; one solution scores best and you see how close you were.
hook: An optimisation puzzle with a hidden optimum.
risk: Might be read as allocation advice; label synthetic and educational.

name: Loss Lesson Daily
loop: One anonymised losing trade is told as a short story; at three decision points guess what the trader did next, then see the real choice.
hook: Loss-focused narrative honours the never-hide-losses principle.
risk: Re-identification and shaming of real traders; need consent and aggregation.

name: Number Line Guess
loop: Estimate a hidden statistic of a masked path (return, max drawdown) as a 80% range; the result grid shows hit or miss per question.
hook: Calibration puzzle with a score that is easy to understand.
risk: Statistics jargon; use plain wording.

name: Paper Trade Haiku
loop: Exactly three paper decisions on a seeded path; your result is rendered as a tiny three-line glyph, a visual signature to show friends.
hook: Short, artistic share object instead of numbers.
risk: Cosmetic rewards might attach to returns; tie them to completion only.

name: Cause And Effect Cards
loop: Draft three cards from a daily pool of market forces (rates, supply shock, sentiment) then see which actually explain the masked chart's move.
hook: Deck-draft thinking turned into a puzzle with a causal answer.
risk: Causal claims about real events can mislead; show as one interpretation.

name: Daily Ladder Of Ten
loop: Ten masked calls climb a ladder; each correct call raises stakes of points, a miss drops you a rung but you always finish all ten.
hook: Finite and forgiving while still tense.
risk: Point stakes mimic betting; keep points non-transferable and clearly toy.

name: Night Shift Ticker
loop: Each evening set a probability that tomorrow closes higher for the day's featured broad index; resolved next day, season rating tracks calibration.
hook: Daily ritual tied to real markets, calibrated not gambled.
risk: May look like market advice; no named instruments in shares and disclaimers.

name: Blind Spot Grid
loop: A daily grid reveals which kinds of puzzles you tend to miss (gaps, reversals, slow trends) after you finish, building a personal weakness map.
hook: Self-knowledge payoff rather than raw score.
risk: Pseudo-diagnostic claims about the player; keep descriptive.

name: Two Truths One Fake
loop: Three performance claims about a masked record, two computed from data and one invented; flag the invented one.
hook: Trains scepticism toward too-good-to-be-true performance.
risk: Invented claims could be screenshotted out of context; watermark as quiz.

name: Co-op Mystery Chart
loop: A pair of friends each see different clues of the same masked chart and must agree on answers through a short guarded chat of preset phrases.
hook: Cooperative deduction with information asymmetry.
risk: Chat moderation; preset phrases only to avoid tips or personal data.

name: Tower Of Drawdowns
loop: Ride a seeded synthetic path as long as you dare; release before a hidden drawdown threshold hits, and the shared result shows your exit point only.
hook: Chicken-style tension with a single daily attempt.
risk: Hold-to-ride rewards recklessness; ensure loss shown equally and capped.

name: Spot The Seasonality
loop: Twelve months of a masked asset are overlaid; identify which month-of-year pattern is real and which is noise by testing against a shuffled control.
hook: Teaches false patterns via a concrete puzzle.
risk: Seasonality could be presented as a tradable edge; frame as noise-teaching.

name: Fork In The Path
loop: A masked story with three forks where you choose a paper action; endings are shared as a path code that friends can compare without spoilers.
hook: Choose-your-own-path gives variety on a single seed.
risk: Paper outcomes may be seen as proof of skill; include luck framing.

name: Sorted By Surprise
loop: Five masked daily moves; sort them from least to most surprising relative to prior volatility.
hook: Teaches volatility scaling without equations.
risk: Explaining surprise needs careful simple language.

name: Monthly Mega Puzzle
loop: A longer weekend puzzle with ten linked masked charts and a final deduction question that uses answers from earlier ones.
hook: Weekend ritual with depth for dedicated players.
risk: Long sessions drive time sink; hard cap and reminders.

name: Two Minute Warm Up
loop: A tutorial-like puzzle series: each day teaches one concept, and finishing unlocks the next concept card plus a harder variant next week.
hook: Education path that makes the daily puzzle a curriculum.
risk: Condescension; allow skip.

name: Head To Head Cone
loop: Challenge a friend: both draw a cone for the same masked path; whoever has the narrower cone that still holds wins, shown after both finish.
hook: A wager of confidence, not money.
risk: Cones framed as predictions on assets once unmasked; keep masked.

name: Collect The Stories
loop: Each solved puzzle adds a one-paragraph lesson to a personal field guide; the guide has a finite 365 entries, giving a year-long completion goal.
hook: Completionist pull without competition.
risk: Completion goals can create streak anxiety; allow archive catch-up.

name: Time Zone Relay
loop: Play at any hour; calls lock at a daily cutoff and results come next morning, with the leaderboard split by region to be fair.
hook: Fair global puzzle with a clear resolution moment.
risk: Real data correlation with trading hours may push live-market watching.

name: Jigsaw Candle
loop: A masked chart is cut into six shuffled segments; swipe them back into a plausible continuous path using level continuity and volatility clues.
hook: Tactile jigsaw feel; not about prediction at all.
risk: Weak link to verified records; fine as acquisition hook.

name: Beat The Median Trader
loop: Predict outcomes of ten anonymised verified trades and compare your calibration to the community median ghost's.
hook: Ghost comparison to a crowd, not a person.
risk: Anonymised verified data used in a game needs consent in terms.

name: Hold Or Fold Grid
loop: Five open paper positions are shown at a random mid-point; swipe hold or exit on each, and the shared grid shows percent results only.
hook: Practises exit decisions, the neglected half of trading.
risk: Reads as sell advice if the positions are unmasked; keep masked.

name: Daily Sixes
loop: Six short paths each end at a known gap; call whether the gap closed or widened, and the share grid shows six squares colored by correctness.
hook: Minimal rules, a grid people can post in chats.
risk: Low risk; keep disclaimer on every shared grid.

name: Cone Of Silence
loop: A synthetic path pauses; set the narrowest cone you trust, then the cone grid in your share shows only whether you were inside, never the values.
hook: One gesture, one idea: honest uncertainty.
risk: Minimal; ensure synthetic label on every screen.

name: Cipher Of Returns
loop: Four return numbers are encoded as chart shapes; match each number to its shape, learning how percent moves look on a 0% axis.
hook: Visual numeracy puzzle aligned with the percent-only chart rule.
risk: Dry; needs strong visual polish.

name: Day Zero Seed
loop: Players share only a seed code; entering it replays the exact puzzle, so friends can attempt the same path on any day.
hook: Seed codes make puzzles portable and archive-free.
risk: Seed sharing leaks answers; accept as unranked replays.

name: Calibration Ladder
loop: Eight claims with probabilities you set; the daily result is a reliability bar showing whether your 70% calls came true about 70% of the time.
hook: Calibration as an identity metric with friends.
risk: Over-interpreting small samples; show uncertainty bands.

name: Quiet Day Puzzle
loop: Choose which of three masked days was the quiet one with no major move; trains reading noise, since many days are boring.
hook: Counterintuitive: the puzzle about nothing happening.
risk: None significant; may feel anticlimactic.

name: Gauntlet Of Gaps
loop: Pass through five masked overnight-gap rooms, choose to hold or flatten before each, and one random relic modifies a room; run is shared as relic icons.
hook: Roguelike drama on a shared seed with one attempt.
risk: Relic lootbox perception; relics are fixed by seed, not purchasable.

name: Anonymous Pair Ranking
loop: Two anonymised track records are shown by win rate and confidence interval; swipe toward the one the lower-bound ranking would put first.
hook: Teaches why sample size matters, matching the app's ranking rule.
risk: Anonymised records need k-anonymity thresholds.

name: Friend Group Seed
loop: Each friend group gets its own private seed each day, so results are never comparable across groups; a season ends monthly with a group trophy.
hook: Private small-circle play with no global pressure.
risk: Trophies might drive group churn; keep cosmetic.

name: What Changed Overnight
loop: Two near-identical masked charts differ by one altered segment; tap the edit, a spot-the-difference tuned to chart reading.
hook: Accessible puzzle for non-traders.
risk: Little on-brand depth.

name: Sudden Stop Survival
loop: Keep calling a synthetic path until you miss; the day's board ranks how many you called, but only one run is allowed.
hook: Sudden death with strictly one try.
risk: Streak multiplier invites gambling feel; restrict to display only.

name: Reverse Odds Puzzle
loop: You are told the true outcome first and must estimate what fraction of players guessed it; surprise at the crowd's answer is the payoff.
hook: Inverted hindsight puzzle teaching how bad hindsight is.
risk: Confusing; needs clear onboarding.

name: Slow Burn Week
loop: One call per day on a masked path that unfolds over the week, with each day's reveal adding one bar, so a friends board builds suspense until Sunday.
hook: Serial storytelling in a minute a day.
risk: Daily obligation; skipping must not break the board.

name: Pattern Of The Day
loop: Find the chart in a grid of twelve whose shape matches a named pattern, then see how often that pattern fell apart in the data.
hook: Teaches that patterns often fail.
risk: Pattern names may sound like signals; show failure rates prominently.

name: Three Guess Lock
loop: You have three guesses to name the hidden chart's era; each wrong guess gives a hint bar and the colored feedback is shared as a spoiler-free row.
hook: Classic guess-with-feedback loop in a trading wrapper.
risk: Era hints narrow towards identifiable events; use wide buckets.

name: Mirror Of Yesterday
loop: Yesterday's puzzle resolves with today's close; open the app to see how your call fared and unlock today's, so the daily visit is one tap each way.
hook: Built-in return reason with a natural overnight wait.
risk: Trains daily check-in habit; keep light and skip-friendly.

name: Assemble The Equity Curve
loop: Ten anonymised trade results (percentages only) are shuffled; order them to reproduce the final curve shown at the top.
hook: Arithmetic sequencing puzzle that shows order effects.
risk: Verified-record reuse needs consent.

name: Fog Of History
loop: A masked chart reveals progressively less fog every ten seconds; commit a range early for a bonus or wait for safer clues.
hook: Time pressure traded against information.
risk: Countdown pressure; keep timer gentle and optional.

name: Pairs Of Paths
loop: Two masked assets run side by side; call which outperforms over the hidden window, and a friend's ghost answers appear after you commit.
hook: Relative choice is simpler than absolute prediction.
risk: Reads as pick-the-winner advice once unmasked.

name: Sabotage The Chart
loop: One friend edits a synthetic path by choosing a shock; the other predicts its direction; roles swap on the next day's seed.
hook: Asymmetric duel: author versus solver.
risk: Shock authoring could encode hints; limit to preset shocks.

name: Edge Or Luck Verdict
loop: Shown anonymised stats of a trader with a confidence interval; judge whether the record is distinguishable from luck, then see the test result.
hook: Core product value (trust in records) as a puzzle.
risk: Statistical verdicts on real records may be read as defamatory; anonymise heavily.

name: Season Of Puzzles
loop: A thirty-day season of daily puzzles; your rating is calibration-weighted and ends on a reset with a small cosmetic frame.
hook: Season arcs with real end points and fresh starts.
risk: Season resets can feel punishing; keep cosmetic only.

name: Shadow Of The Crowd
loop: After you lock your probability, the crowd's average appears as a faint shadow on the slider; your share grid marks whether you beat it.
hook: Simple crowd comparison with no names.
risk: Anchoring if shadow is visible before commit; show after.

name: Drawdown Maze
loop: Navigate a maze whose walls are drawdown limits, choosing branches that represent exposure levels, and finish with the smallest worst dip.
hook: Spatial metaphor for risk in a daily maze.
risk: Metaphor may trivialise risk; label synthetic.

name: One Word Retro
loop: After the reveal, pick the single word (patience, panic, luck, discipline) that best explains what the price did; compare to the crowd's top word.
hook: Reflective ritual with low stakes.
risk: Vague scoring; treat as poll not score.

name: Staggered Release
loop: Three puzzle drops per day at set hours (morning, noon, evening), each a different shape of problem, with a combined daily grid.
hook: Multiple small appointments instead of one long session.
risk: Notification-heavy; compulsion risk of three check-ins.

name: Bold Bonus Round
loop: A daily final question lets you double your score or lose it on a confident call; one all-in decision closes the puzzle.
hook: A dramatic final beat that people discuss.
risk: Double-or-nothing resembles gambling; points only, deliberate bold idea.

name: Puzzle Cartographer
loop: A map of finite puzzle regions unlocked by solving neighbours; each region teaches one chart concept and the map is complete after a fixed set.
hook: Adventure-map structure with an end state.
risk: Finite content; refresh cost.

name: Sync Solve
loop: A weekly live event where everyone solves the same masked path in the same three minutes while a ticker shows the share of players choosing each answer.
hook: Appointment viewing with crowd energy.
risk: Crowd ticker induces herding; delay it until after lock.

name: Second Opinion
loop: Make your call, then send it to one friend who sees only your confidence, not your direction; their blind guess is scored against yours.
hook: Tests whether confidence itself carries information.
risk: Odd to explain; needs a short tutorial.

name: Archive Of Losses
loop: An archive of puzzles built only from historically painful drawdowns, ordered by theme, practising recognising danger shapes.
hook: Counterweight to win-focused games.
risk: Distressing for some players; provide opt-out.

name: Anagram Of Tickers
loop: Guess the sector of a masked company from five bars of volatility signature and one business-model clue, with no names used.
hook: Trivia-style deduction in a trading setting.
risk: Sector reveals could identify a listed company; use wide groups.

name: Cornered Call
loop: Hold a thumb on the screen while a synthetic path runs and release to exit; the daily glyph is drawn by your thumb's timing.
hook: Tactile and distinctive share art.
risk: Hold mechanics echo slot machines; limit to one ride.

name: Handicap Day
loop: Friends with different ratings get different clue amounts so a newcomer can fairly compete against a veteran; the grid shows handicap used.
hook: Fair mixed-skill play among friends.
risk: Handicap fairness complexity and perceived pity.

name: Crossroads Chart
loop: At each of four forks in a masked path you pick a paper stance; the share image shows your route as a branching line with no values.
hook: Visual signature of your decisions.
risk: Stances may be read as recommendations when unmasked.

name: Bias Of The Day
loop: Each day is built to tempt one cognitive bias (recency, anchoring); after reveal you see how far your answers leaned toward it.
hook: Self-discovery puzzle with a named lesson.
risk: Diagnostic claims; frame as game feedback.

name: Group Chart Quilt
loop: Each friend's daily result fills one square of a shared quilt; a week of squares forms a pattern the group can screenshot.
hook: Collective artefact rather than ranking.
risk: Absent friends leave holes; fill neutrally.

name: Bluff The Board
loop: Share a probability with a friend that may be honest or a bluff; they guess which, and both scores depend on the path's actual result.
hook: Social deduction layered on prediction.
risk: Teaches deception; bluffing in finance context is off-brand.

name: Lifetime Of One Seed
loop: Live a compressed forty-year paper investing life in five minutes, making a few savings decisions as events happen, and share only your path shape.
hook: Narrative arc with a personal ending.
risk: Reads as retirement planning advice; strict educational label.

name: Stat Detective
loop: Given three headline stats of an anonymised record, infer the hidden fourth (trade count, average loss, holding time) from consistency clues.
hook: Number-sleuthing satisfies spreadsheet minds.
risk: Combining stats can reverse-identify; use bucketed values.

name: Rolling Wave Daily
loop: A single masked path is revealed in waves; you call each wave once, and everyone's wave-by-wave accuracy is plotted as a daily crowd curve.
hook: Crowd curve is a fresh public artefact each day.
risk: None major; ensure no personal data on curve.

name: Dawn Brief Puzzle
loop: Each morning one question about a broad index resolves at the close, such as will it move more than one percent; set a probability and get the score that night.
hook: Real-world resolution gives stakes without money.
risk: May be read as market commentary; use generic wording.

name: Memory Chart Deck
loop: Study a masked chart for ten seconds, then draw cards of redrawn candidates and swipe the true one; each correct unlocks a deck slot for tomorrow's harder set.
hook: Memory challenge with deck growth.
risk: Ladder pressure; make unlocks cosmetic.

name: Rain Check Archive
loop: If you miss a day you can play it later with a visible late stamp, and friends see it as a lighter square, so nobody loses a streak.
hook: Kind to irregular schedules.
risk: Late play may see spoilers; separate board.

name: Pace Yourself
loop: A puzzle that rewards stopping early: after each of five rounds you may bank your score or continue, and a wrong round loses only that round.
hook: Teaches knowing when to stop, a rare design goal.
risk: Push-your-luck design; cap at five rounds.

name: Plain Language Puzzle
loop: One masked chart and a one-line description of a statistic; choose the plain-language meaning from three options, a daily glossary hit.
hook: Newcomer-friendly learning disguised as a puzzle.
risk: Educational tone; keep playful.

name: Twin Paths
loop: Two masked paths begin identically; guess which split into the winner, then replay as your friend ghost's answers fade in.
hook: Looks identical until it doesn't, showing luck in outcomes.
risk: Little risk; reveals randomness.

name: Daily Wheel Of Risks
loop: Each day a modifier is spun by seed (wide spreads, no overnight, double volatility) and everyone plays the same synthetic path under it.
hook: Daily rule twist keeps a simple puzzle fresh.
risk: Spinner visual resembles gambling; use a static calendar instead.

name: Verification Heist
loop: A weekly story where you play an auditor spotting inconsistencies in a fictional trading record; fictions are clearly marked and never based on real people.
hook: Detective fantasy aligned with the verification brand.
risk: Fictional records mimicking real ones may blur Verified trust.

name: Crowd Versus You
loop: Everyone sets a probability for the same masked path, and the daily board ranks calibration, not wins, with a minimum of ten days to appear.
hook: Fair, noise-resistant ranking that mirrors the app's lower-bound rule.
risk: Slow to feel rewarding; show personal curve early.

name: Final Page
loop: A finite puzzle book of 365 days with a clear last page; once you finish the year the book closes, and the app suggests going back to the real records.
hook: A game designed to end, which suits the trust brand.
risk: Revenue-light by design; deliberate bold anti-engagement idea.
